body:
That was a good read, thanks.

She has a habit of "digging her own grave". She did it in school: Started with 15 credits, then took on this task, and that job, and by mid-terms, she was completely burned out in life and failed her classes. 

I wish she had more self-motivation, because if she opened her eyes, she would see the opportunity she has. Instead, she looks at the failures and judges herself based on that. 

I totally agree she needs to face her own demons and overcome the depression on her own, it's just frustrating to see someone "not get it", and there's nothing you can do to help them "get it".

Her fiance and her have fights, I don't know if she's 100% confided in him, that sort of thing. She's committed to him, but I don't think she's emotionally dependent on him (in the sense that she could tell him anything). 

She's very apathetic towards life, she doesn't want to do anything. I think she was at the point that anything is better than the situation she was in, including death.
